decision.text: The live sheet does not use VoiceStrip (decision d-voicestrip, 2026-10-17): its controls are ext/Chat Composer's row (ComposerMic button, gear, Send) inside Widget.Composer. So DictationBar takes that composer's mic and hides its row, instead of replacing a VoiceStrip. Alternative: a new Dictate beside the composer (a second engine, rejected: law 6, one mic). Strip size gets a compact bar in the live row.
